feature: Inspector search restores each accordion group's prior user state

finding.reproduction: In Chromium, all Inspector groups started collapsed. Searching for the typography font-size field correctly opened its group, but clearing the search left aria-expanded=true and the group visually open instead of restoring its prior collapsed state.
finding.impact: A transient search changed persistent Inspector disclosure state. Repeated searches accumulated open groups and made the Inspector less predictable, while visual and screen-reader expansion state stayed synchronized to the unwanted open state.
finding.fix: Inspector search expansion is now transient. A search-state event opens only visible matching groups without overwriting the user's saved disclosure state; clearing the query restores the state recorded by the existing accordion controller. Manual open/close actions remain persistent across subsequent searches.
finding.reuse_review: The repository's existing inspector-groups controller and openGroups map remain the source of truth. Native DOM CustomEvent coordinates the independently loaded Inspector search and accordion modules. No external library or dependency was needed.
